newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July orders rise due to special factors -- EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan July orders rise due to special factors -- EPA.

text.p: A strong month-on-month rise in Japan's private machinery orders for July was mainly due to special factors, including big orders in the manufacturing sector, an Economic Planning Agency (EPA) official told reporters on Tuesday.

The EPA earlier announced that Japan's private-sector machinery orders in July, excluding those for machinery at electric power firms and ships, rose a seasonally adjusted 13.6 percent from the previous month to 1.19 trillion yen.

"If we take out the effects of these special factors, the rise in the private machinery orders could have been between eight and nine percent," the official said. "Therefore, we can say machinery orders were continuing a slow recovery."
A 50.9 percent month-on-month rise in machinery orders from external demand contributed to the strong orders. "The yen's fall against the dollar helped pushed up exports," he added.
